responsibility: Defines the SPU target’s core backend configuration macros and public target data structures for GCC. It specifies storage layout, endian and alignment rules, register file and register classes, calling convention registers and elimination rules, addressing and trampoline properties, assembly syntax and symbol emission conventions, target default masks and processor enums, builtin descriptor structures, and hook macros that bind generic GCC interfaces to SPU-specific functions, serving as the architectural contract for the whole SPU port.
same_name_distinction: This header declares the SPU port’s compile-time interface—target macros, enums, register/configuration constants, and public builtin descriptor types—consumed by spu.c and aligned with constructs referenced from spu.md. Unlike spu.c it does not implement hooks, and unlike spu.md or spu.opt it is not a machine-description or option-definition file.
